blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Language models generate useful drafts and suggestions, but fluent output is not guaranteed to be correct. Supply relevant context, verify important results, protect sensitive data and choose the simplest suitable level of AI.

blocks.title: Generation and context
items: Models generate responses one token at a time
Tokens are pieces of text, not always whole words
Context windows have finite token capacity
Long context can still miss relevant details
Later work may need a compact, explicit handoff

blocks.title: Verify before relying
items: Check facts against reliable sources
Confirm citations exist and support the claim
Inspect generated code and run relevant tests
Recompute totals with explicit rules
Label unsupported claims as unverified

blocks.title: Share safely
items: Remove passwords, access keys and other secrets
Replace personal details with synthetic examples
Share only the material the task needs
Check current provider and organizational rules
Revoke or rotate exposed secrets appropriately

blocks.title: Choose a level
items: No AI: direct work or deterministic tools
Chat: ideas, explanations and suggestions
Coding agent: permitted multi-step tool use
More capability adds oversight, cost and delay

blocks.title: A compact handoff
items: Goal: the intended outcome
Current state: what already exists
Decisions: rules and choices to preserve
Next task: the immediate work
Checks: evidence needed before acceptance

blocks.body: The human remains responsible for requirements, secrets, permissions, integration and release.
